jobs.description: The photo ladder backlog (root ADR-0429, ADR-0427 §7): every hour, the display ladders a photo's own collector run left (its budget ran out, or the store refused) are made from the Silver photo indexes the shared media store's contract names (data-go-kr-onbid.contract.json media.ladder_backlog.index_tables, today silver.court_auction_item_photo), through the same media_renditions::ensure_ladders the collectors call. Partial: a table whose Iceberg snapshot did not move is not read; otherwise only its rows from the newest source run taken on are added to the pending sources kept under its state path; a source whose ladder is there costs one HEAD. A new ladder version starts every table over. Bounded by media.ladder_backlog (1,500 sources, 4 at a time, 1,500 s). Writes only write-once rendition objects under the store's renditions/ prefix.

per_run_cap.unmeasured_reason: Not enabled and never run as its unit in the journal (new 2026-11-06); enabling it needs an attended run measured first (root ADR-0386 §3).
